input: Sign up for a local community first aid class

gold.taskTitle: Sign Up for a Local Community First Aid Class
gold.taskDescription: Find and register for a first aid class available in the user's local community.

questions.title: Which city or neighborhood should the search focus on?
questions.description: Identify the user's location to find relevant local class options.

questions.title: What specific certification level are you aiming for?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants basic first aid, CPR, BLS, or a full certification course.

questions.title: Do you have a deadline by which to complete this?
questions.description: Understand if there is a time pressure driving the registration.

questions.title: Are weekday or weekend class times preferable for you?
questions.description: Narrow down scheduling options that fit the user's availability.

questions.title: Is this for personal use or a professional requirement?
questions.description: Clarify the motivation to prioritize the right type of course and provider.

questions.title: Do you have a budget limit for the course fee?
questions.description: Identify any cost constraints that would filter out certain providers.

questions.title: Do you prefer an in-person class or would online count?
questions.description: Determine the format preference to guide the search for available options.
